data.long_description:
This spacious 3-bedroom residential unit offers a well-designed layout with 4 modern bathrooms, ideal for families seeking comfort and functionality. The apartment spans 1,426.43 sq. ft., providing generous living and dining areas with excellent natural light.

The unit is offered unfurnished, allowing residents the flexibility to design and furnish the space according to their personal style. It is chiller-free, ensuring reduced utility costs.

Located on a high floor, the apartment boasts a full park view, creating a serene and green outlook. A large, well-appointed balcony enhances the living experience, perfect for relaxation or outdoor seating.

Building & Community Amenities:

Dedicated children’s play area
Swimming pool for residents
Fully equipped gymnasium
24/7 security with CCTV surveillance
Two allocated parking spaces
Well-maintained common areas and controlled access

This property combines space, views, and premium amenities, making it an excellent choice for families or professionals looking for a high-quality living environment.
